newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Miguel unit awards soda contract.
newsitem.headline: San Miguel unit awards soda contract.

text.p: Philippines' Mabuhay Vinyl Corp (MVC) was awarded a 42 million peso contract by a unit of San Miguel Corp to supply liquid caustic soda, a Mabuhay Vinyl official said.
MVC vice president Mario Alba told reporters on Tuesday that under the contract, MVC will supply the San Miguel Brewing Group with 3,000 tonnes of liquid caustic soda this year.
The soda is a chemical used in bottle washing to ensure removal of all unwanted solid and liquid materials.
Mabuhay is an unlisted company but plans to float shares later this month.
